sonicScene.thesis: The Tidewriter: a stylized ocean at electric twilight where the music is written into the sea. The bass's last fifteen seconds roll in as swell, every kick sends a lifted front in from the horizon, highs glint on the sun's path, held sound swells the sun's halo; dolphins leap across the sun's reflection, and a performer can raise a hero wave, fire a leap, bloom the crests or let night fall.

composition.background: a violet-to-coral sky, twilight stratus lit coral round the sun, a hazy island on the left third
composition.midground: rows of Gerstner swell with cyan light through their backlit crests
composition.foreground: the near swell, its foam caps and the sun's broken path
composition.focal: the low cream sun on the right third and its column of glints
secondary: dolphins leaping across the sun's path
foam ribbons on the highest crests
composition.atmosphere: distance flattens the far sea into colour and glitter; clouds haze into the sky
composition.post: a little bloom on the sun and the glints
composition.camera: still: 12 m over the water, 45 mm, the horizon on the upper 40 %

palette.background_value: mid (a coral horizon under a violet sky)
palette.saturation: indigo and violet, one cyan accent, one warm light; night and golden hour are the palette's two related ends (CC 1, CC 7)

very_slow: the cloud field turning round the viewer
the swell growing with the piece
medium: three Gerstner trains in three directions
the bass's history rolling in as swell
fast: the sun's halo breathing with held sound

vocabulary: TIDEWRITING: what the bass played rolls in as swell, taking ~15 s from 400 m out to your feet
a lifted front rolls in from 70 m out; the crest light and foam flash
the long swell grows with loudness (slowly)
STRUCTURE: the swell's crests sharpen as the piece builds
the glints on the sun's path flare
the sun's halo swells and its path on the water warms
the whole palette drifts a little warmer or cooler
a burst of sparks on the sun's path: low notes near, high notes far, velocity is how many
NIGHT: dusk falls into a bioluminescent night
SWELL: the long and cross swells rise
CHOP: the wind sea roughens, more glints
FOAM: foam caps on more crests
SUN: halo, glow and the sun's path
TIDE: how deep the music writes into the sea
SPRAY: how much the drums and notes throw
LEAP: a dolphin arcs across the sun's path
HERO WAVE: one big swell rises far out and rolls in, foaming
BLOOM: bioluminescence along every crest, fading over seconds
FLARE: the sun flares and settles
SPRAY: a gust of spray off the near swell
the swell rolls on, the clouds drift, pods of dolphins leap every 31 and 47 s
sonicScene.tier: light: 78k sea vertices (three pieces) through 8 deformers, five unlit programs (48 ops on the near sea), 196 cloud puffs, six dolphins, fixed particle pools; no lights, no shadows, no fog march
sonicScene.title: Digital Ocean
